title: best app i have
body:
never seen an app so useful like this one. it's incredible how something so simple can make you save so much time. 
i go to school and they give us a lot of homework and i used to almost never finish it. This app made me realize how much of that time I spent on my phone instead of studying. i thought "well, it's only ten minutes, no harm right?" but minutes add up and become hours and you don't even know it. 
with this app you just finish your stuff and there's no way you lose that time on social media (for example). you have only like half a minute or so to maybe check a message or change the music, but no time to check instagram or twitter (and by doing so, archive nothing)
